shared_component_placement.note: Physical colocation grows as inherent accessor families expand; selected-feature compilation is measured separately.

interpretation: Counts exclude unconditional support. Resource features include their HTTP API; models reused by request signatures also contribute. No decoder domain flags were explicitly enabled for these profiles.

compile_comparison.method: Warm both dependency graphs, then two alternating before/after runs. Clean all resolved SDK path packages and probe before each project-clean check; retain registry/build dependencies. Warm checks immediately follow. Exploratory local timings on one machine, not a controlled benchmark.
